market.question: Will the highest temperature in London be 12°C on May 6?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office forecast for London May 6 caps high at 14°C with overcast and showers. Polymarket trader consensus sits 14°C (45.5%) and 13°C (41.5%). For high to land at exactly 12°C the day would need to underperform forecast by 2°C, which is unusual when the day is already partly in progress.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover persistence and afternoon temperature trajectory
